about:
Fourteen ratings from Table 31.6 of the Spanish edition: three single doors and four pairs of communicating doors, each rated unsealed ("STC (sin sellar)") and well sealed ("STC (bien selladas)"). The door is the name and the sealing the variant.

The single doors print a surface density in kg/m2. The four pairs print theirs as "7 each" or "20 each", in English inside the Spanish edition, which is the mass of one door of the pair; the construction's own surface density is not printed, so those rows hold the cell as printed and serve no number.
